p.src: 1  But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

en: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
u.src: 1  But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

p.src: 2  For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

en: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?
u.src: 2  For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

p.src: 3  And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

en: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.
u.src: 3  And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

p.src: 4  For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
u.src: 4  For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

p.src: 5  But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

en: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
u.src: 5  But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

p.src: 6  This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

en: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
u.src: 6  This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

p.src: 7  so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

en: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
u.src: 7  so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

p.src: 8  Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

en: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
u.src: 8  Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

p.src: 9  For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

en: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
u.src: 9  For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

p.src: 10  Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

en: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
u.src: 10  Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

p.src: 11  that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

en: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
u.src: 11  that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

p.src: 12  Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

en: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
u.src: 12  Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

p.src: 13  I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

en: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

p.src: 14  Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

en: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
u.src: 14  Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

p.src: 15  For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

en: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:
u.src: 15  For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

p.src: 16  to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

en: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

p.src: 17  For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
